body.error: correlationId is required and must not be empty.

parameters.query: @concat('SELECT TOP 1 * FROM dbo.BtpConfig WHERE CorrelationId = ''', replace(variables('correlationId'), '''', ''''''), '''')
@concat('SELECT TOP 1 * FROM dbo.SolaceClient WHERE CorrelationId = ''', replace(variables('correlationId'), '''', ''''''), '''')
@concat('SELECT TOP 1 * FROM dbo.MuleSoftPartner WHERE CorrelationId = ''', replace(variables('correlationId'), '''', ''''''), '''')

@concat('SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.SolaceMessageType mt JOIN dbo.SolaceClient c ON mt.ClientId = c.Id WHERE c.CorrelationId = ''', replace(variables('correlationId'), '''', ''''''), ''') AS SolaceMsgTypesCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.MuleSoftEnvironment mt JOIN dbo.MuleSoftPartner c ON mt.PartnerId = c.Id WHERE c.CorrelationId = ''', replace(variables('correlationId'), '''', ''''''), ''') AS MuleSoftEnvironmentsCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.MuleSoftTransactionType mt JOIN dbo.MuleSoftPartner c ON mt.PartnerId = c.Id WHERE c.CorrelationId = ''', replace(variables('correlationId'), '''', ''''''), ''') AS MuleSoftTransactionTypesCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.MuleSoftMessageType mt JOIN dbo.MuleSoftPartner c ON mt.PartnerId = c.Id WHERE c.CorrelationId = ''', replace(variables('correlationId'), '''', ''''''), ''') AS MuleSoftMessageTypesCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.MuleSoftSourceDestination mt JOIN dbo.MuleSoftPartner c ON mt.PartnerId = c.Id WHERE c.CorrelationId = ''', replace(variables('correlationId'), '''', ''''''), ''') AS MuleSoftSourceDestinationsCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.MuleSoftUomMapping mt JOIN dbo.MuleSoftPartner c ON mt.PartnerId = c.Id WHERE c.CorrelationId = ''', replace(variables('correlationId'), '''', ''''''), ''') AS MuleSoftUomMappingsCount')

@concat('SELECT TOP 100 Id, Domain, CorrelationId, EntityKey, Channel, CASE WHEN ActorEmail IS NULL OR ActorEmail = '''' THEN '''' WHEN CHARINDEX(''@'', ActorEmail) > 0 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(ActorEmail, 2), ''***'', SUBSTRING(ActorEmail, CHARINDEX(''@'', ActorEmail), 320)) ELSE ActorEmail END AS ActorEmail, EventType, EventDetail, CreatedAt FROM dbo.EnrichmentAuditLog WHERE CorrelationId = ''', replace(variables('correlationId'), '''', ''''''), ''' ORDER BY CreatedAt ASC')
@concat('SELECT TOP 1 * FROM dbo.OnboardingApproval WHERE CorrelationId = ''', replace(variables('correlationId'), '''', ''''''), '''')

@concat('SELECT mt.MessageType AS messageType, mt.Topic AS topic, mt.QueuePermission AS queuePermission, mt.QueueEgressEnabled AS queueEgressEnabled, mt.QueueMaxRedeliveryCount AS queueMaxRedeliveryCount FROM dbo.SolaceMessageType mt JOIN dbo.SolaceClient c ON mt.ClientId = c.Id WHERE c.CorrelationId = ''', replace(variables('correlationId'), '''', ''''''), ''' ORDER BY mt.Id')

@concat('SELECT e.Environment AS environment, e.NavHost AS navHost, e.NavCompany AS navCompany, e.NavSoapPath AS navSoapPath, e.NavRoutingCode AS navRoutingCode FROM dbo.MuleSoftEnvironment e JOIN dbo.MuleSoftPartner p ON e.PartnerId = p.Id WHERE p.CorrelationId = ''', replace(variables('correlationId'), '''', ''''''), ''' ORDER BY e.Id')

@concat('SELECT t.TransactionTypeCode AS transactionTypeCode, t.TransactionTypeEnabled AS transactionTypeEnabled, t.TransactionTypeLabel AS transactionTypeLabel FROM dbo.MuleSoftTransactionType t JOIN dbo.MuleSoftPartner p ON t.PartnerId = p.Id WHERE p.CorrelationId = ''', replace(variables('correlationId'), '''', ''''''), ''' ORDER BY t.Id')

@concat('SELECT m.MessageType AS messageType FROM dbo.MuleSoftMessageType m JOIN dbo.MuleSoftPartner p ON m.PartnerId = p.Id WHERE p.CorrelationId = ''', replace(variables('correlationId'), '''', ''''''), ''' ORDER BY m.Id')

@concat('SELECT sd.SourceDestinationFrom AS sourceDestinationFrom, sd.SourceDestinationTo AS sourceDestinationTo FROM dbo.MuleSoftSourceDestination sd JOIN dbo.MuleSoftPartner p ON sd.PartnerId = p.Id WHERE p.CorrelationId = ''', replace(variables('correlationId'), '''', ''''''), ''' ORDER BY sd.Id')

@concat('SELECT u.UomFrom AS uomFrom, u.UomTo AS uomTo FROM dbo.MuleSoftUomMapping u JOIN dbo.MuleSoftPartner p ON u.PartnerId = p.Id WHERE p.CorrelationId = ''', replace(variables('correlationId'), '''', ''''''), ''' ORDER BY u.Id')

body.readyToLaunch: @and(and(greater(length(coalesce(body('Get_Btp_Row')?[0], body('Get_Btp_Row'), json('[]'))), 0), greater(length(coalesce(body('Get_Solace_Row')?[0], body('Get_Solace_Row'), json('[]'))), 0)), and(greater(length(coalesce(body('Get_MuleSoft_Row')?[0], body('Get_MuleSoft_Row'), json('[]'))), 0), and(and(equals(coalesce(first(coalesce(body('Get_Btp_Row')?[0], body('Get_Btp_Row'), json('[]')))?['EnrichmentStatus'], 'AwaitingInput'), 'Complete'), equals(coalesce(first(coalesce(body('Get_Solace_Row')?[0], body('Get_Solace_Row'), json('[]')))?['EnrichmentStatus'], 'AwaitingInput'), 'Complete')), equals(coalesce(first(coalesce(body('Get_MuleSoft_Row')?[0], body('Get_MuleSoft_Row'), json('[]')))?['EnrichmentStatus'], 'AwaitingInput'), 'Complete'))))

@and(and(greater(length(coalesce(body('Get_Btp_Row')?[0], body('Get_Btp_Row'), json('[]'))), 0), greater(length(coalesce(body('Get_Solace_Row')?[0], body('Get_Solace_Row'), json('[]'))), 0)), and(greater(length(coalesce(body('Get_MuleSoft_Row')?[0], body('Get_MuleSoft_Row'), json('[]'))), 0), and(and(equals(coalesce(first(coalesce(body('Get_Btp_Row')?[0], body('Get_Btp_Row'), json('[]')))?['EnrichmentStatus'], 'AwaitingInput'), 'Complete'), equals(coalesce(first(coalesce(body('Get_Solace_Row')?[0], body('Get_Solace_Row'), json('[]')))?['EnrichmentStatus'], 'AwaitingInput'), 'Complete')), equals(coalesce(first(coalesce(body('Get_MuleSoft_Row')?[0], body('Get_MuleSoft_Row'), json('[]')))?['EnrichmentStatus'], 'AwaitingInput'), 'Complete'))))
